result.topic_en: Riemann recasts the equations of motion as a minimum principle in the manner of Gauss's least constraint. The acceleration function and a force potential P make the motion over time dt minimise a quantity, read as a balance of competing 'strivings' (inertia and the potential), with gravitation as a double integral over mass elements.
